scope: Independent full-row scan of five selected contract, quote, opportunity, marketplace tax and order-product account tables using the unchanged geography scanner.
company_attribution_status: Not established by this aggregate batch
limitations: This separate five-table batch supplements the 26-table discovery batch. Neither batch is a full-archive row analysis.
Hong Kong geography is a source-record signal, not verified headquarters, residence, corporate identity, production use or compromise.
Contracts and quotes contain billing or recipient geography. Their account_id fields require a validated account join before company attribution; contract and quote names are not company labels.

Opportunity Country_for_AWS__c is an AWS opportunity role. Company_Name_for_AWS__c and Account_Name_Original__c are not supported by the unchanged scanner label allowlist. These observations are geography only.

Marketplace taxed_customer_country and taxed_customer_city concern the taxed customer. The scanner does not support taxed_tenant_name as a label. The modeled customer-to-tenant relationship requires separate validation before company attribution.

Only the combined order-product account source contributes candidate company rows, through account_name. These are repeated account labels on order-product records, not unique companies or orders; source lineage and data_source populations were not reviewed.
The geography-only sources may contain company-related information that this scanner does not extract. A zero candidate count does not mean that such information is absent.
No source-specific account, tenant, infrastructure or support joins were performed in this batch. Candidate labels, private source paths, identifiers and raw records are excluded from this export.
